    • performOperation

      ConnectionAction performOperation(ConnectionOperationType connectionOperation, String description, Object bodyObject)
      Performs a connection action (accept, reject, retry...) and returns the action result (spec schema ConnectionAction). Call refresh() afterwards to re-read the connection's updated state.
      Parameters:
      connectionOperation - the action type
      description - action description (e.g. rejection reason)
      bodyObject - optional action data
      Returns:
      the ConnectionAction returned by the API
